title: 三輪コーヒーカート
description: 公園や駅前で営業する、前2輪の三輪自転車型コーヒーカートです。荷台の箱と木の天板、前面の販売口のふた、スポーク付きの前輪2つと後輪、フレーム・サドル・クランク・ハンドル、ストライプの屋根と支柱、エスプレッソのボイラーとグラインダー、紙コップの束を造形しています。店名やロゴ、メニューの文字、走行・調理の動作は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.851 × 1.821 × 0.767 m、16,112三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A front-loading tricycle coffee cart for parks and station plazas. It models the cargo box with walnut counter and front service hatch, two spoked front wheels and a rear wheel, frame, saddle, cranks and handlebar, a striped canopy on posts, an espresso boiler, grinder and a stack of paper cups. Shop names, logos, menu text and riding or brewing motion are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.851 × 1.821 × 0.767 m; 16,112 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
